policy_note.String: VersionedProjectPolicy: apply to the explicit baseline normal-battle route in both run families. Fragment drops, extra selections, base rarity/path weighting, rerolls, elite/boss rewards and other acquisition triggers remain pending, not zero-effect policies. Domain-specific higher-rarity base pools and other drops remain pending; separate exact Curio domain rewards execute before this offer.

replacement_condition.String: Replace individual width, membership, rarity/Path weights, exhausted-pool behavior, suppression snapshot timing and encounter binding when released current execution data or reproducible observations establish them. summary_en.String: After a normal battle victory, choose one offered unowned base Blessing. Active reviewed suppression prevents the offer.
